data.title: Client Profile Approval and Client Interview
data.content:
# Client Profile Approval and Client Interview

The candidate profile is submitted to the end client for review, followed by a client-side interview round.

### Pass Condition
The client approves the profile submission and signs off on the technical and culture match after the interview.

specimens.label: Client review status

lines.text: Profile submitted to client for approval

specimens.reading: The candidate remains in an external waiting state where decision authority sits with a party not named on the requisition.

perspectives.sees: A curated batch of candidate profiles forwarded by vendors, evaluated against internal delivery timelines.
perspectives.reads: Profiles are supplier proposals; reviewing them carries no direct employment commitment.
perspectives.does: Selects preferred profiles for a client interview or rejects without detailed feedback.

perspectives.sees: A candidate who passed vendor screening, awaiting feedback from the client account manager.
perspectives.reads: Time-to-feedback is dictated by the client; the vendor cannot advance the candidate unilaterally.
perspectives.does: Follows up with the client contact while keeping the candidate warm with generic holding updates.

perspectives.sees: An extended delay after vendor interviews, followed by an additional external round.
perspectives.reads: The interview process includes an unannounced external decision gate.
perspectives.does: Prepares for a client interview whose evaluation criteria and contractual context are opaque.

perspectives.sees: Commercial margin targets dependent on placing candidate billable hours on the client contract.
perspectives.reads: Candidate placement directly realizes project revenue once client sign-off is secured.
perspectives.does: Monitors client approval rates and manages bench fallback options.
